rating.comments: The first message is the pasted task, so it was ignored. The student's later messages are mostly fragments or lists such as "negative influence, obsession, comparing yourself" and "wasted time, insecure, weird". The fuller message "The teenagers would have wasted hours scrolling without doing anything... They also might become insecure" gives brief reasons, which earns reasoning 3. Knowledge building is 2 because the student mainly restates the same themes (insecure) without extending earlier messages. There are no questions, and effort is 3 because there are several on-topic attempts but little follow-through.
